payload.text: Molt 1.4.0 rollout on rhadamanth (released 3 Nov: d0a4518, tap 814de96). In order: hv runs brew upgrade molt; vc commits and pushes the karabiner enable in Molt-matts' rhadamanth molt.toml; hv quits Karabiner's Settings window and runs molt upgrade; then 0081's proof (readlink, verify, Karabiner's log Load line, Caps Lock as Control on the built-in keyboard and the Keychron B11 Pro, one Settings toggle showing as a Molt-matts diff); then rhadamanth-sysadm uninstalls Homebrew's mise and asdf (0082). kovacs and gyges move to 1.4.0 on hv's word.
